source.title: FAO GSOCseq technical manual, Chapter 2: Soil Organic Carbon sequestration
source.locator: 2.4 Estimating SOC sequestration potential; equations 2.1 and 2.2

comparators: business as usual at common horizon

interpretation_limit: Sequestration is stock change over time or relative to a management counterfactual. An annual rate divides change by the stated horizon. A stock map alone does not measure additional sequestration potential.
registration_blocker: No GSOCseq dataset binding, management scenario, common horizon or accepted benefit-class interpretation.
